x-changelog.summary: Introducing v1.0 Create Budget Changes endpoint
x-changelog.description: Introduction of Public API endpoint for creating Budget Change records.

x-changelog.summary: Enabling Attachment Support for Create Budget Changes endpoint
x-changelog.description: Allows attachment params to be used when creating a Budget Change. Requires that content type is multipart form data.

x-changelog.summary: Number is optional for Create Budget Changes endpoint
x-changelog.description: Number is now optional. If not provided, it will be assigned.

x-changelog.summary: Extend Budget Change create endpoint request to support Production Quantity
x-changelog.description: The budget change POST request will now accept and return the Production Quantities when creating a new Budget Change as 'production_quantities'.

x-changelog.summary: Extend Budget Change create endpoint to support association of Change Event Production Quantities
x-changelog.description: The budget change create request will now accept and return the Change Event Production Quantity IDs associated to a Budget Change Production Quantity as 'change_event_production_quantity_id' on a `production_quantity` object.

x-changelog.summary: Add wbs_code_id to POST API endpoint
x-changelog.description:
'wbs_code_id' is now an accepted parameter for creating Budget Change Production Quantity.
As well, 'wbs_code' is now a property of the response of a successful Budget Change Production Quantity creation.

x-changelog.summary: We added new "currency_configuration" property to (create) POST API endpoint response.
x-changelog.description: The "currency_configuration" will now be a property of the API response when the user creates a new Budget Change.

x-changelog.summary: Creating change event adjustment line items does not require adjustment number
x-changelog.description: The budget change create endpoint does not require the adjustment_number parameter and will auto-assign it if it is not given when creating adjustment line items of type 'change_event'

x-changelog.summary: The Budget Change Create endpoint allows creation with an associated prime contract
x-changelog.description: When the "Allow budget changes to be billed on owner invoices" setting is active, the Budget Change create endpoint will accept a prime contract id to associate with the budget change. The response includes information about the associated prime contract.
